Pixel OS v1.6.8 — 1:1 iOS 26 Control Center Gesture & Privacy Fix on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Hooks Home Screen right-half swipe-down in NexusLauncherRelease (v17.6.8-ios26) to open 1:1 iOS 26 Control Center directly instead of stock Android Quick Settings, while keeping left-half swipe-down for Notifications
• Decouples DirectBoot-safe SamuraiIos26CcTrigger (TYPE_NAVIGATION_BAR_PANEL, Z-layer 25) from Compose panel creation so top-right bezel swipes work reliably across apps, Home Screen, and Lock Screen
• Removes ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION and WifiManager SSID polling from IosControlCenter, permanently eliminating the blue status-bar Location privacy indicator
